name: Recon and OSINT Footprinting Against SocioProphet Infrastructure

sigma_dns_recon.title: DNS Subdomain Enumeration Against SocioProphet Domains
sigma_dns_recon.description: Detects DNS subdomain brute-force and zone transfer attempts. Based on TTP analysis: recon_osint appears in 121/1016 SG security accounts (12%). Common tools: amass, subfinder, dnsrecon, fierce, dnsx, massdns.
sigma_dns_recon.author: SocioProphet/SCOPE-D

sigma_github_recon.title: GitHub API Enumeration — Org/Member/Repo Discovery
sigma_github_recon.description: Detects mass enumeration of GitHub org members, repos, and social graph — the pattern used by SG network actors to build target lists before attacking. Also catches tooling like SeeRepo (SG's own codebase graph tool used against us).
falsepositives: Internal GitHub Actions CI (add CI runner IP to allowlist)

osquery_recon_tools.description: Detect OSINT/recon tools running locally that target SocioProphet infrastructure. Focus on tools found in the SG network: amass, subfinder, theHarvester, Maltego, recon-ng, spiderfoot, shodan CLI.
osquery_recon_tools.query: SELECT p.pid, p.name, p.cmdline, p.start_time, u.username FROM processes p JOIN users u ON p.uid = u.uid WHERE p.name IN ('amass', 'subfinder', 'theHarvester', 'recon-ng', 'spiderfoot', 'dnsx', 'massdns', 'dnsrecon', 'fierce', 'shodan') OR p.cmdline LIKE '%socioprophet%' OR p.cmdline LIKE '%sourceos%' ORDER BY p.start_time DESC LIMIT 20;

github_traffic_monitor.description: Monitor GitHub traffic API for clone spikes suggesting systematic recon. Threshold: >10 unique cloners in 24h on any SocioProphet/mdheller repo. CI alert via fingerprint_monitor.py (already deployed, 6h cadence).

expectedEffect: Detect footprinting activity before it escalates to active exploitation. recon_osint in 121/1016 accounts is likely under-counted — many accounts use benign tool names. The github_traffic_monitor and fingerprint_monitor (already live) are the primary detection surface; DNS/process rules catch more targeted probing.
falsePositiveRisk: MEDIUM for DNS burst rule — CDN and health check traffic can trigger. LOW for GitHub audit log burst (30+ API calls in 10min from single actor is unambiguous). LOW for osquery process names.
deploymentGate: DNS rule requires access to DNS query logs (Cloudflare DNS or self-hosted resolver). GitHub audit log rule requires GitHub Enterprise or org audit log streaming. osquery rule deployable immediately on any monitored host.
